drills.title: Close It Out Right
drills.description: The last ambulance is gone. Is the incident really over? Make the right call.

items.prompt: Last red patient just left. Release all 20 units?
options: Release in phases; keep some for late finds/rehab

items.prompt: Best timing for a hot wash?
Ambulance used for decon-zone patients at a chemical incident.
items.why: Contaminated equipment endangers the next crew and patient.

items.prompt: Crew member is quiet but says 'I'm fine'. You…
options: Force them to describe it in detail
Check in (PFA), offer support, follow up later
items.why: Look, Listen, Link — offer, don't force.

items.prompt: AAR finding: 'Staging was chaotic.' What makes it useful?
options: Add a specific fix, an owner, and a deadline
items.why: Improvement plans need actions, owners, and dates.

items.prompt: Firefighter changed 2 SCBA cylinders in heavy work.
Six weeks later, a medic has nightmares and is drinking heavily.
options: Refer to professional and peer support
items.why: Persistent symptoms with functional impact need referral.
